scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix shared && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:shared" "npm run start:client" "npm run start:server"
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
